definitions.value: Total money received from both subscriptions and one-time purchases.
definitions.revenue_basis: Gross revenue: the total revenue, including taxes and store commission fees.
definitions.freshness: Transactions, installs, paywall views and flow events reach the analytics at least 15 minutes after Adapty receives them. Numbers of past days can still change: a refund that the store reports later takes the revenue out of the day of its purchase.
